tickets.title: Prepare care-cost runway projection for Cloudpuddle household
tickets.text: Prepare a care-cost runway projection for Helena and Martin Cloudpuddle comparing the current Pocket Lantern Home Care schedule (32 hours per week at $38 per hour) with a higher-coverage scenario, showing when the $142,000 in Teacup Comet Bank reserves and the $615,000 Velvet Acorn Custody joint taxable account would require an increased withdrawal above the current $2,250 monthly transfer.
tickets.evidence: Helena asked for a care-cost runway projection comparing the current aide schedule with a higher-coverage scenario and showing when cash reserves would require an increased taxable-account withdrawal; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-01-05.

tickets.title: Document family caregiver reimbursement approach for Cloudpuddle
tickets.text: Document a family caregiver reimbursement approach for Helena and Martin Cloudpuddle that distinguishes gifts, wages, and shared household costs, reflecting Lila Cloudpuddle's reduced clinic hours covering weekday transportation and medication supervision.
tickets.evidence: Lila is reducing her clinic hours to cover weekday transportation and medication supervision, and Helena wants a documented family caregiver reimbursement approach that does not blur gifts, wages, and shared household costs; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-01-12.

tickets.title: Collect long-term care claim file materials from Amber Teapot
tickets.text: Obtain the full long-term care insurance policy contract, claim packet, and elimination-period instructions from Amber Teapot Life Insurance for Martin Cloudpuddle's policy, which references a 90-day elimination period and a $210 daily benefit limit, so the claim file is complete.
tickets.evidence: For long-term care claim file materials, Helena had the premium notice but not the full policy contract, claim packet, or elimination-period instructions requested by Amber Teapot Life Insurance; those materials are needed by 2024-01-10.

tickets.title: Reconcile Pocket Lantern Home Care invoice hours
tickets.text: Reconcile the Pocket Lantern Home Care portal billed aide hours for the first service week against Helena Cloudpuddle's calendar and aide sign-in sheet so the home-care invoice amount is ready for planning assumptions.
tickets.evidence: Pocket Lantern Home Care’s portal shows more billed aide hours for the first service week than Helena’s calendar and aide sign-in sheet, so the home-care invoice amount is not ready for planning assumptions; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-01-03.

tickets.title: Prepare financial questions for Cloudpuddle rehab care conference
tickets.text: Prepare financial questions and affordability figures for Helena and Martin Cloudpuddle to bring to the rehab team's near-term care conference reviewing home therapy authorization and daily supervision, including the impact of Pocket Lantern Home Care's 32 hours per week at $38 per hour and the household's $8,900 monthly Social Security and pension income against $7,400 baseline spending.
tickets.evidence: The rehab team set a near-term care conference to review home therapy authorization and daily supervision, and Helena wants financial questions and affordability figures ready for that conversation; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-01-08.
